name: Insulated Screwdriver Set
tagline: VDE-rated turners for terminal screws — the handles that keep a flash off you.
parts: VDE-tested insulated shaft — double-insulated to 1000 V
Hardened steel tip — fits the screw head without cam-out
Moulded handle — colour-coded size and symbol icon
Ferrule / bolster — stops a slip sliding down the blade
safety: The insulation is only the protection after you have isolated the circuit. Re-test the tool before trusting it — cracks or carbon tracks in the shaft are grounds to retire it.

points.label: Screwdriver tip
points.detail: The blade is shaped to the screw slot (Phillips, Pozidriv, or flat). A worn or wrong-size tip 'cams out' under torque and chews the head — replace it rather than fighting it.

points.label: VDE-insulated shaft
points.detail: Two layers of insulating material over the steel core, tested to 1000 V AC. The next ring is the colour band that marks VDE-rated tooling (not merely 'insulated grip').

points.label: Bolster / ferrule
points.detail: The raised collar at the handle base stops your fingers sliding onto the shaft while you tighten a terminal deep in a box — overlap that guard and you have shortened your reach.

points.label: Moulded handle
points.detail: The iconic orange/yellow handle is colour-coded by driver size across a set and embossed with the component icon (slotted, Phillips, etc.). The rubber grip is also what you grab to twist a tight terminal.
